passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations (“MD&A”) is intended to provide a reader of our financial statements with a narrative from the perspective of our management on our financial condition, results of operations, liquidity and certain other factors that may affect our future results. Unless otherwise noted, transactions and other factors significantly impacting our financial condition, results of operations and liquidity are discussed in order of magnitude. Our MD&A should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and related Notes included in Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data, of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Refer to Item 7, Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, in our Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended February 1, 2025 , for discussion of the results of operations for the year ended February 1, 2025, compared to the year ended February 3, 2024, which is incorporated by reference herein. Overview We are driven by our purpose to enrich lives through technology and our vision to personalize and humanize technology solutions for every stage of life. We accomplish this by leveraging our combination of tech expertise and a human touch to meet our customers’ everyday needs, whether they come to us online, visit our stores or invite us into their homes. We have two reportable segments: Domestic and International. The Domestic segment is comprised of our operations in all states, districts and territories of the U.S. and our Best Buy Health business, and includes the brand names Best Buy, Best Buy Ads, Best Buy Business, Best Buy Essentials, Best Buy Health, Best Buy Marketplace, Geek Squad, Imagine That, Insignia, Lively, Jitterbug, My Best Buy, My Best Buy Memberships, Pacific Kitchen and Home, TechLiquidators and Yardbird; and the domain names bestbuy.com, lively.com, techliquidators.com and yardbird.com. Our International segment is comprised of all operations in Canada under the brand names Best Buy, Best Buy Ads, Best Buy Business, Best Buy Express, Best Buy Marketplace, Best Buy Mobile, Geek Squad, Insignia and TechLiquidators and the domain names bestbuy.ca and techliquidators.ca. Our fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest the end of January. Fiscal 2026, fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2024 ended on January 31, 2026, February 1, 2025, and February 3, 2024, respectively. Fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025 each included 52 weeks. Fiscal 2024 included 53 weeks with the 53 rd week occurring in the fiscal fourth quarter. Unless otherwise noted, references to years within the MD&A section of this report relate to fiscal years, not calendar years. Our business, like that of many retailers, is seasonal. A large proportion of our revenue and earnings is generated in the fiscal fourth quarter, which includes the majority of the holiday shopping season. We launched and began to scale Best Buy Marketplace within our Domestic segment and grew our retail media network, Best Buy Ads. We believe we were able to both make investments in our strategic initiatives and expand our operating margin through a combination of disciplined expense management and efficiency optimization efforts. Goodwill and intangible asset impairments in fiscal 2026 were related to Best Buy Health. A change in Best Buy Health’s customer base during the third quarter of fiscal 2026 resulted in an impairment review of all Best Buy Health assets. The impairments reflect downward revisions of our revenue growth rates and margin rates compared to previous projections, in part due to pressures in the Medicaid and Medicare Advantage markets. credit_strengths.text: The balance sheet carries a net cash position, with unrestricted cash exceeding interest-bearing borrowings, so gross leverage sits well below the consumer discretionary sector median and the indicative financial risk profile is minimal. This cushion gives the retailer room to absorb seasonal working capital swings without incremental funding.

Operating cash flow comfortably funds capital expenditure, leaving free cash flow that covers the debt stack more than once over. Cash conversion is strong relative to sector peers, reflecting the negative working capital model of a consumer electronics retailer that collects receipts ahead of paying vendors.

key_risks.text: Operating margin is thin and well below the sector median, leaving little buffer if gross profit rate slips. Management attributes the modest comparable sales recovery to computing and mobile phones, offset by declines in home theater and appliances, so mix shifts and tariff-driven cost pressure could compress earnings quickly.

Disclosed impairments and restructuring show execution risk in adjacencies: goodwill and intangible write-downs at Best Buy Health followed a customer-base change and pressure in Medicaid and Medicare Advantage, while labor and store optimization charges recurred. These signal that diversification beyond core retail is not yet earning its cost of capital.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is far above the sector median, and interest expense is small relative to operating income, so debt service is not a binding constraint. The modest absolute debt load and absence of tagged short-term borrowings or commercial paper suggest limited refinancing risk in the near term.

Liquidity is adequate rather than ample: the current ratio sits modestly below the sector median, consistent with a seasonal retail model, but current liabilities are large relative to cash. Free cash flow after capital spending covers shareholder distributions, though dividends and buybacks absorb most of it, leaving a thin residual for debt reduction.

overall_credit_view.text: Our judgement is that credit quality is strong: net cash, high interest coverage and free cash flow exceeding debt point to a low-risk profile, and leverage has been stable across the trend period. The main sensitivity is earnings, not funding, given thin margins and tariff exposure in a discretionary category.

Forward-looking, we expect the issuer to remain net cash absent a large debt-funded action, but shareholder returns consume most free cash flow, so the cushion may not build. Continued restructuring and Health impairments would weigh on earnings quality; we would monitor margin recovery and distribution policy as the key swing factors.

credit_strengths.text: 資產負債表持有淨現金狀況，未受限制現金超過計息借款，因此總槓桿遠低於非必需消費品行業中位數，指示性財務風險狀況為極低。此緩衝讓該零售商有空間吸收季節性營運資金波動，而無需增量融資。
營運現金流足以輕鬆支應資本支出，留下的自由現金流可覆蓋債務結構超過一次。相對於行業同儕，現金轉換強勁，反映消費電子零售商先收取款項後支付供應商的負營運資金模式。

key_risks.text: 營業利潤率偏薄且遠低於行業中位數，若毛利率下滑則緩衝有限。管理層將溫和的同店銷售復甦歸因於電腦與手機，抵銷了家庭影院與家電的下滑，因此產品組合轉變及關稅驅動的成本壓力可能迅速壓縮盈利。
已披露的減值與重組顯示鄰近業務的執行風險：Best Buy Health 的商譽及無形資產減值發生於客戶基礎變化以及 Medicaid 與 Medicare Advantage 壓力之後，而勞動力與門店優化費用則反覆出現。這些跡象表明，核心零售以外的多元化尚未賺回其資本成本。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，且利息支出相對於營業收入較小，因此償債並非約束性因素。絕對債務負擔溫和，且沒有標記的短期借款或商業票據，表明近期再融資風險有限。
流動性屬於充足而非充裕：流動比率略低於行業中位數，與季節性零售模式一致，但流動負債相對於現金較大。資本支出後的自由現金流可覆蓋股東分派，儘管股息與回購吸收了大部分，留下的債務削減餘額有限。

overall_credit_view.text: 我們的判斷是信用質量強勁：淨現金、高利息覆蓋率及超過債務的自由現金流指向低風險狀況，且槓桿在趨勢期內保持穩定。主要敏感因素在於盈利而非融資，鑑於非必需類別的利潤率偏薄及關稅敞口。
前瞻而言，我們預期發行人將維持淨現金，除非出現大規模債務融資行動，但股東回報消耗大部分自由現金流，因此緩衝可能無法累積。持續重組及 Health 減值將拖累盈利質量；我們將監測利潤率復甦及分派政策作為關鍵搖擺因素。
